payload.title: Audit cleanup (low priority): Anth.us-web
payload.description:
**Problem**
Low-priority findings from the anth.us / anthus-site-content audit.

**Evidence / Fix** (checklist)
- [ ] README title is "# Anth.us-Papyrus" and its layout/build sections are stale; update.
- [ ] Session notes commodity-receipts.STYLE-NOTES.txt and commodity-receipts.IMAGE.txt are committed in the content repo; remove.
- [ ] About 10 dead external links in articles; find with a link checker over the crawl and fix or remove.
- [ ] automated-scientific-discovery.mdx:21 has a relative arxiv.org link (missing https://); make it absolute. (The http://project-plan.md autolink part is filed centrally.)
- [ ] Tag pages 404 for tags used only by draft articles; hide the tag links or render the pages.
- [ ] Home page title is "Home | Anthus"; use a descriptive title. https://anth.us/sitemap.xml returns 404 (re-checked 2026-10-20); generate a sitemap.

**How to verify**
Each box: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://anth.us/sitemap.xml` returns 200; `curl -s https://anth.us/ | grep -o '<title>[^<]*'` is descriptive; grep for the stale README title and the two notes files finds nothing; link checker reports no dead links.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
